content:
olivia: Who's up for a half-court shootout in the parking lot Friday at lunch? :basketball: I’ll bring plain and maple donuts for the winners :doughnut: (suggested donation $5 to the office charity jar)
aj: lol yes. count me in. can i bribe the shooter with coffee? :coffee: 
sam: I will 100% miss but will cheer and be loud. can we do a tiny bracket?
leo: tiny bracket sounds fun. 8 players? winner takes donuts and bragging rights. losers buy coffee.
marcus: @olivia love the charity idea. which charity? also can we add a fantasy twist — +3 points if you hit a banked half-court? :thinking_face:
olivia: thinking local youth rec center. and yes to fantasy twist. i’ll keep scoreboard.
aj: rules proposal (quick):
```
- 8 players single-elim
- 3 attempts per match (closest to basket if tie)
- banked shots = +3 bonus points (fantasy pool)
- $5 charity donation per player or sponsor
```
sam: adding a fantasy pool is dangerous but i’m in. how do we track picks? spreadsheet or slack thread?
olivia: spreadsheet link: https://tiny.redwood/halfcourt (i'll update after signups). post picks here with emoji to confirm.
leo: sign me up :raised_hands:
marcus: sign me up :point_up: and i nominate @aj as the designated hype man
aj: honored. will bring portable speaker and an unfortunate 'pump-up' playlist. :sunglasses:
calendar-bot: Event created: "Half-Court Donut Derby" Friday 12:30pm — invite sent to #random.
marcus: 2 quick logistics — weather backup plan? and do we get a foam ball or real? safety first.
olivia: backup: lobby hallway free-throw challenge if raining. foam ball with a taped target for half-court attempts.
sam: can we have a consolation prize like a bag of bagels for the 3rd place? keeping it wholesome. :bagel:
leo: love it. last Q: do fantasy points affect our office fantasy football scoring secretly? :eyes:
olivia: only if you promise not to trade me your top WR for half-court glory :stuck_out_tongue:
aj: okay roster leak: aj officially terrible at banked shots, amazing at trash talk.
marcus: noted. see y'all Friday. i'll Venmo $5 to @olivia and leave a note for the rec center. :white_check_mark:
